en_quote: To understand and control financial crime risks associated with banking products, you should:
knowledge_zh: 关键要点列表引导：为理解和控制银行产品相关的金融犯罪风险应采取的行动

en_quote: Conduct a thorough risk assessment of your organization’s banking products and services.
knowledge_zh: 对组织的银行产品和服务进行彻底的风险评估

en_quote: Assess the systems and controls currently in place to determine if they are adequate for the level and type of risk your organization faces.
knowledge_zh: 评估现有系统和控制措施是否足以应对组织面临的风险水平和类型

en_quote: Learn from past compliance failures to ensure you avoid similar ones in the future.
knowledge_zh: 从过去的合规失败中学习，避免未来重蹈覆辙

en_quote: Pursue continuing training so you can stay up to date on best practices in banking compliance.
knowledge_zh: 持续接受培训以了解银行合规最佳实践的最新动态
